description: Protect an open perp position: reduce-only trigger orders that close the whole position when the mark price crosses trigger_price. Signed locally. Cancel one with cancel_order; move it by cancelling and setting a new one.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation so it is not executed twice.

market.description: Market symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL (see get_markets)

name: set_position_tpsl
title: Set position stop-loss / take-profit
